title: Potatoverse Science Model Testing Protocol
abstract: This protocol converts the repository's science wing from a collection of equations and analogies into an auditable modeling programme. Every model must identify the mathematical role of each equation, the state variables and parameters it acts on, physical units when applicable, a baseline explanation, an observation map, uncertainty, identifiability, calibration method, prediction and falsifier. Cross-domain analogies require explicit translation maps, and cross-scale claims require a coarse-graining/channel map. The protocol preserves speculative and symbolic models as legitimate research objects while preventing them from being mislabeled as established physical theories.
purpose: Make the science wing richer without allowing analogies, decorative equations or later formalizations to drift into unsupported physical claims. Every equation should acquire a defined scientific job.

equation_roles.meaning: Defines a quantity; does not by itself predict dynamics.
Specifies evolution and therefore requires state, parameter and initial/boundary conditions.
Chosen functional form used to make a hypothesis calculable; must be labeled rather than presented as derived fact.
Maps model/latent state to observed quantities.
Specifies probability of observations conditioned on parameters/model.
Established equation imported to sharpen structure; not project validation.

measurement_contract.uncertainty: epsilon is assigned a stated probability/error model or interval; physical/empirical values should not be reported without uncertainty when it is material.
measurement_contract.standardized_residual: r_i=(y_i-yhat_i)/sigma_i when a scalar uncertainty sigma_i is appropriate
measurement_contract.rule: Separate measurement uncertainty, parameter uncertainty and model discrepancy. A fit without an error model is incomplete.

dimensional_analysis_contract.rule: Every additive physical equation must have compatible dimensions on every term; [LHS]=[RHS].
dimensional_analysis_contract.dimensionless_priority: Before defining a multi-variable threshold or similarity law, construct dimensionless ratios/groups where possible.
dimensional_analysis_contract.buckingham_pi: For n dimensional quantities with dimensional-matrix rank k, seek n-k independent dimensionless Pi groups under the usual Buckingham-Pi framework.

cross_scale_contract.question: Does the proposed micro-level mechanism reproduce the macro-level evolution after coarse-graining within a declared approximation error?
cross_scale_contract.fail_action: Do not infer the macro phenomenon merely by naming a microscopic phenomenon. Classify the cross-scale mechanism as unresolved.

cross_domain_analogy_contract.test: Compare T_AB(F_A(X)) with F_B(T_AB(X)) when a dynamical relation is claimed.
cross_domain_analogy_contract.mismatch: Record which structure is preserved and which properties/units/causal claims are not.
cross_domain_analogy_contract.fail_action: If no mapping or preserved relation can be stated, keep the comparison as loose metaphor rather than formal scientific analogy.

identifiability_and_sensitivity.fisher_information: I_ab(Theta)=E[(partial_a ln p(Y|Theta))(partial_b ln p(Y|Theta))] under standard regularity assumptions
identifiability_and_sensitivity.warning: A model can fit data while parameters remain non-identifiable. Highly similar sensitivity columns or flat likelihood directions mean the parameter interpretation is weak.
identifiability_and_sensitivity.action: Prefer nested minimal models and estimate only parameters that the available observables can distinguish.

baseline_and_prediction.null_model: Every novelty claim names M0: the simplest established or project baseline that already explains the observation.
baseline_and_prediction.candidate_model: M1 adds the proposed mechanism or parameter.
baseline_and_prediction.evaluation: Use held-out prediction, likelihood/information criteria, residual structure or another predeclared comparison appropriate to the domain.
baseline_and_prediction.anti_overfit: Coordinates, inclusion criteria and hyperparameters selected after seeing the target pattern must be marked exploratory.
baseline_and_prediction.stronger_evidence: Predeclared mapping + out-of-sample prediction + uncertainty + baseline comparison outranks retrospective numerical coincidence.

tests.name: provenance
tests.question: Can the exact equation or statement be tied to a dated source?
tests.fail_action: mark unrecovered or later-formalized; never attribute as verbatim Tim.

tests.name: equation-role
tests.question: Is this expression a definition, identity, law, constraint, ansatz, measurement equation, statistical model or comparator?
tests.fail_action: do not let an ansatz/definition masquerade as a derived physical law.

tests.name: variable-definition
tests.question: Does every symbol have a defined meaning and mathematical type?

tests.name: units
tests.question: Are physical dimensions/units stated and consistent?
tests.fail_action: not eligible as a physical equation until repaired.

tests.name: nondimensionalization
tests.question: Can raw dimensional controls be reduced to meaningful dimensionless groups?
tests.fail_action: do not construct arbitrary scalar thresholds by adding unlike units.

tests.name: domain
tests.question: What space does the model act on: physical spacetime, graph, probability manifold, state space, chronology, symbolic ontology?
tests.fail_action: do not compare results across domains as if identical.

tests.name: dynamics
tests.question: What determines evolution or transition?
tests.fail_action: classify as static taxonomy/geometry rather than dynamics.

tests.name: boundary
tests.question: What initial, boundary, guard or interface conditions select the solution?

tests.name: observability
tests.question: What quantity could actually be measured or computed?

tests.name: measurement-map
tests.question: How does latent/model state produce the recorded measurement?
tests.fail_action: do not equate internal variable with instrument/data output.

tests.name: uncertainty
tests.question: Are experimental uncertainty, parameter uncertainty and model discrepancy distinguished?
tests.fail_action: do not report precision unsupported by the data/model.

tests.name: identifiability
tests.question: Can different parameter values be distinguished using the available observables?
tests.fail_action: report only identifiable combinations or add measurements.

tests.name: novelty
tests.question: What does this model explain or predict beyond existing theories?
tests.fail_action: retain as analogy, educational model or reframing.

tests.name: falsifiability
tests.question: What outcome would count against the model?
tests.fail_action: do not describe as empirical scientific theory.

tests.name: baseline
tests.question: What established theory already explains the phenomenon?
tests.fail_action: compare against baseline before invoking new force/dimension.

tests.name: known-limit
tests.question: Does the model recover the established theory in the parameter regime where the new effect is supposed to vanish?
tests.fail_action: model is incomplete or conflicts with known physics.

tests.name: cross-scale
tests.question: If the argument crosses scales, is there a defined channel/coarse-graining map and error estimate?
tests.fail_action: do not infer macro consequence from micro vocabulary alone.

tests.name: overfitting
tests.question: Were parameters, coordinates or target selections chosen after seeing the pattern?
tests.fail_action: label exploratory and require out-of-sample test.

tests.name: category-boundary
tests.question: Is a mathematical analogy being mistaken for physical identity?
tests.fail_action: split the records and add an explicit boundary note.

theory_quality_ladder.name: mathematical toy
theory_quality_ladder.gate: equations internally typed/dimensionally consistent; assumptions explicit

theory_quality_ladder.name: calibrated model
theory_quality_ladder.gate: parameters inferred from data with uncertainty and identifiability analysis

theory_quality_ladder.name: independently replicated theory
theory_quality_ladder.gate: prediction/model survives independent data or implementation

evidence_labels.B: project formalism clearly documented but later than originating intuition

publication_rule: Every public science page should make clear whether displayed mathematics is Tim-authored/recovered, archive-generated, or external established mathematics. Every empirical-looking number should state source, unit, uncertainty/precision and whether it was measured, fitted, assumed or derived.
